title: तीस FIR
status_note: Cue sheet only. Nothing generated, nothing listened to. A separate runner generates the five one-offs once each; the library cues are generated once for the series (content/series2/sound/library.json) and only referenced here.
authority: D-011 reuse: library cues by cue_id, one-offs only where the library lacks a sound
D-009 route b; D-0M4 method approved; D-019 Gate 2: s2a02 passed (7.9)
D-014 rule 6 / D-0M2: shots follow measured voice, so every placement is anchored to a beat, line id or silence, not to seconds
sources: content/series2/episodes/s2a02/script.en.json (same beat and line ids; music_note identical)
timebase: No shots.json or measured takes exist yet. Placements are anchored to beat ids, line ids and each beat's scripted silence (silent_seconds, silent_position); S13 converts them to seconds from the measured timeline of each language. The same sheet serves the Hindi and English cuts.

ducking: Music ducks 8 dB under every line (attack about 80 ms, release about 400 ms) and the bed ambience 3 dB.
Point effects sit between words; any effect that overlaps a line is at -14 or lower and must not cover a stressed word.
b8 (l17, l18), b9 (l20, l21) and b12 (l29): nothing but the bed under these lines. l29 has no effect on it.
b12: bed, car idle and tension note all duck under l28 and l29; the tension note a further 8 dB.

filters.phone: None in this episode (no phone appears).
filters.behind_door: l03 (door1_man) and l22 (door4_voice) come from behind a door open a hand's width: low-pass at about 5 kHz, slight early reflection from the brick lane, -2 dB against on-screen voices. Every consonant must survive.
filters.off_face: l13 (Shanti over the hands insert) and l21 (Nirala off frame) are in the same space as the picture: dry, no filter.
filters.music_pulse: The b11 clock-tick pulse is high-passed at about 400 Hz and sits on the music bus, so it reads as music, not as a clock in the lane.

music_in_out: b1-b2: no music. The key, the cuff and the chain carry them.
IN: mus_theme_caper_bed on the first knock in b3.
b8: bed 2 dB warmer under the dawn tea.
b9: bed thinned to almost nothing (about -30, low-passed) for the turn; no sting.
b11: clock-tick pulse joins on the b11 cut; bed and pulse lift 3 dB on the salute in the silence after l27.
b12: bed and pulse STOP DEAD on the car-door clunk. mus_tension_note from the clunk under l28-l29, ducked well below the voice. mus_sting on the final insert. Then room tone only and cut to black.
hard_rules: The episode opens on the padlock over black: no music, no fade-in of anything before it but room tone.
Episode ends on a hard cut to black after the sting and the held room tone; nothing carries past the last frame.

beds.out: hard cut at the b2/b3 picture cut
beds.note: Night, 1:20 a.m. Crickets very low: they come through the lockup window, not from the room. No music in b1-b2.

beds.note: The night turns. Shot 1 (page insert) stays night. On shot 2 the one-off sfx_s2a02_lamp_die plays as the lamp goes out; crickets fade out over about 2 s from that moment and lyr_morning_birds fades in from silence (the 'first bird'). The base's own lamp buzz cannot be removed from the loop: from the lamp-die moment the base drops 2 dB and, if the buzz is still audible, a high-pass at about 180 Hz is applied to the base from that point (S13 checks on the generated file).

beds.out: hard cut at the b8/b9 cut

one_off_cues.prompt: A small round tin ink-pad case: the thin metal lid popped open with a light tinny click, then three soft separate thumb presses onto the damp ink pad and onto paper, each a quiet muted dab, close and dry. No voices.
one_off_cues.why_one_off: Only s2a02 uses the ink pad (library one-offs list: 'ink pad tin lid and thumb presses (b4, b7)'). One generation, cut into segments and reused in five beats.

one_off_cues.prompt: A heavy steel drinking tumbler set down on a stone doorstep: one bright, solid metal-on-stone clink. A pause. Then a small glass tea glass set down on a wooden bench: one light glassy knock. Close, outdoors, quiet. No voices.
one_off_cues.why_one_off: Library one-offs list: 'steel tumbler on stone and glasses (b6, b8)'. Both in one generation to save a call; if the take only holds one of the two, the missing one is taken from the other's sound pitched (glass: +5 st, shorter) rather than regenerated.

one_off_cues.prompt: A small outdoor wall lamp on a bracket going out at dawn: its faint electrical buzz flickers twice, falters and dies with a tiny click, then quiet. Close, soft. No voices, no birds.
one_off_cues.why_one_off: Library one-offs list: 'wall lamp buzz dying (b7)'. Used once.

one_off_cues.prompt: A pressure cooker whistle in a kitchen far away across a small Indian town in the morning: one long high steamy whistle heard faintly from several houses off, distant and soft, fading. No voices, no traffic.
one_off_cues.why_one_off: Library one-offs list: kept out of lyr_morning_town so it does not repeat every 30 s. Used once.

one_off_cues.prompt: Two people hurrying on foot down a narrow brick-paved lane, one in hard leather shoes and one in loose oversized shoes that slap a little: at first their quick steps are out of step with each other, then they fall into one shared rhythm, close, outdoors, quiet morning. No voices, no traffic.
one_off_cues.fallback: If the take does not fall into step, build it from two copies of the same take offset by about 0.15 s that converge to 0 over the cue. Do not use sfx_steps_gravel here: gravel reads wrong on a brick lane.
one_off_cues.why_one_off: Library one-offs list: 'hurried footsteps (b11)'. The library's step cues are terrazzo (indoor hall), gravel (yard) and ballast (rails), none a hard lane.
